rule: Per crowd-control family (DR group), a hit reads the level, bumps it for the next hit (only for all-type groups or player-affected targets), then scales this hit's duration by the level read: default 100, 50, 25, then immune; knockback 100 then immune; taunt on creature targets 100, 65, 42.25, 27.46, then immune. Caster-player on player-affected target gets the group's PvP cap (default 8 s). The level resets 18 s after the last aura of the group is removed. A new aura in the same group is refused (bounce) when its post-diminish duration is shorter than the running one. Control states have priority stun > root > confuse > fear; stun also re-evaluates threat suppression. Damage removes interrupt-flagged auras before the absorb check. Stacks clamp to the cap, refresh timers when not lower, and merge same spell from the same caster.

data_fields.name: dr_group
data_fields.unit: enum: root, stun, incapacitate, disorient, silence, knockback, taunt, limit-only

data_fields.name: dr_levels
data_fields.unit: percent array per group; last entry 0 = immune

data_fields.name: dr_reset
data_fields.unit: s after the last aura of the group ends

data_fields.name: pvp_cap
data_fields.unit: s (explicit per group; none by default in our data)

data_fields.name: control_priority
data_fields.unit: ordered list: stun, root, confuse, fear

keep: one diminishing bucket per crowd-control family
discrete level ladder (full, half, quarter, immune)
reset 18 s after the last aura of the bucket ends
bounce rule: a shorter new aura cannot overwrite a longer one in the same bucket
control priority stun > root > confuse > fear
damage removes interrupt-flagged auras before the absorb check
change: our families: stun, root, knockdown, fear, silence, taunt, knockback
bosses and elites only for the bucket (three attackers can chain a stun)
group is a field on each ability row, not a hand-written per-spell table (no silent NONE)
taunt gets its own four-step ladder, not the shared value 3 (T1)
PvP cap explicit per group, not a default 8 s on every grouped spell (T3)
bounce compares remaining with remaining (T4; Aura::GetDuration not read)
look_test: Phone 375 wide, one elite in a three-attacker fight. (A) flat 2 s stun from each attacker; (B) bucket 100, 50, 25 percent then an immune beat, three pips on the enemy bar, resists flash on the immune step. Judge whether B reads as the elite hardening rather than the stun breaking, whether three pips are legible beside the bar at 375 wide, and whether the flash is clear without a text line.
